entities.name: Muhammad Qamar Ibrahim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad Qamar Ibrahim is a Pakistani field hockey player. He was born in Karachi. He won the gold medal at the 1990 Asian Games, beating India 3–2 in the final, and won a bronze medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona.
